title: Armenian reading matching ignores the book identifier
reasoning: The Armenian fetcher selects the first scraped entry whose start/end chapter and verse match the Reading, but it does not compare the book. On dates with multiple readings sharing the same verse range in different books, the service can attach the wrong Armenian text and still return success. Confidence is medium because the excerpt does not show the scraper payload schema, but the current matching predicate is visibly insufficient if book data is available.
recommendation: Include book or normalized passage identity in the matching criteria, or make the scraper return an unambiguous key that can be compared against the Reading.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests were included, and the current implementation would pass tests with only one scraped entry or unique chapter/verse ranges.
suggestedRegressionTest: Provide two scraped Armenian entries with the same chapter/verse range but different books, call fetch_armenian_text for the second book, and assert the saved text comes from the matching book entry.
